description: Risikoerfassung bei der Energiesystemauslegung (RESA) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU). Vorhersage und Quantifizierung von Risiken und benötigten Sicherheitsmargen bei der Auslegung von Energiesystemen basierend auf nur eingeschränkter Datenbasis. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: zeitliche Auflösungen unter 1 Minute möglich, wenn Datengrundlage ausreicht; wegen großer benötigten Rechenleistung aber oft geringere Auflösung. Spatial resolution: regions, municipalities, districts, households. Software: MATLAB; MATLAB Simulink (bisher primär verwendet). The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
